nonclaim: This V2 record checks one exact externally frozen Ferric, tuned vLLM, and tuned SGLang comparison roster, requires equal successful-request, input-token, and output-token work in every aligned window, and recomputes integer input, output, and total-token throughputs, exact medians, the fastest-baseline selection by total-token throughput, and a deterministic paired-percentile-bootstrap 95% confidence interval from externally collected counters. It enforces a 0.95 lower confidence bound but, because raw request events are not present in this schema, does not recompute the externally supplied nearest-rank p99 successful-request arrival-to-terminal latency. It also does not validate the external plan, versions, sources, tuning choices, budget, SLO, collector arithmetic, observation truth, server freshness, hardware behavior, numerical correctness, or independent reproduction; it is not qualification evidence and does not close m1.r33 or M1.

schema.arithmetic: Each engine window carries positive duration_ns, successful_requests, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, and p99_end_to_end_latency_ns plus zero failed_requests. Checked input_tokens+output_tokens must equal total_tokens, and successful_requests, input_tokens, output_tokens, and total_tokens must be exactly equal across all three engines in every aligned window. Each input, output, or total rate is floor(the corresponding token count*1000000000/duration_ns). Even medians are exact reduced rationals. The fastest baseline is the larger median total-token rate, with vLLM winning a tie. The comparison ratio is floor(Ferric_median_total_rate/baseline_median_total_rate*1000000). Ten thousand paired resamples of the thirty aligned recorded total-token-rate windows use SplitMix64 seeded by the SHA-256 identity of a V2 domain-separated policy and observation digest pair. The nearest-rank 250th and 9750th sorted estimates form the deterministic percentile-bootstrap 95% interval, and its lower bound must be at least 950000 PPM.
schema.bindings: The V2 policy freezes exact plan, executable, environment, Ferric and fe2o3 source closures, model, tokenizer, weights, schedule, workload, trace, output-limit, implementation, protocol, source, config, tuning, and equal tuning-budget SHA-256 identities before observation. V1 policy, observation, record, and protocol formats and authorities are not reinterpreted as V2.
schema.latency: Each p99_end_to_end_latency_ns is an externally supplied window counter declared to use monotonic-raw-nanoseconds, the successful-request-arrival-to-terminal-event population, and nearest-rank-p50-p90-p99-over-the-declared-latency-population. The V2 checker enforces positive counters and exact median-versus-SLO arithmetic but, because observations do not carry raw request events, does not recompute or validate the declared per-window p99 aggregation.
schema.order: Exactly three starts appear in ascending order. Each contains ten ordered warmup windows followed by ten ordered recorded windows. Every window carries the exact cyclic Ferric/vLLM/SGLang execution order and all three raw counter sets.
schema.output: The checker rereads an exclusive held sibling staging file, publishes with renameat2 RENAME_NOREPLACE, synchronizes the parent, and finally rebinds and rereads the published pathname. The V2 record carries the exact policy bindings, raw rows, input SHA-256 identities, separate recomputed input/output/total-token median throughputs, the externally supplied p99 end-to-end median and explicit input-trusted latency semantics, fastest baseline, Ferric total-throughput ratio, bootstrap seed identity, and paired-bootstrap interval. Submitted summaries are outside the input schema.
